_README: Per-client Amazon SP campaign config. Copy to config.<client>-<market>.json (gitignored; only this TEMPLATE is committed). The agent fills campaigns[] from the operator's text brief. Never carry another client's values. Run: python3 tools/amazon-campaign-builder/build_campaigns.py --config <this file> --preflight → --preview → then --config <this file> to build. Output is a bulk-upload FILE only; uploading it in Campaign Manager > Bulk Operations is a separate operator-confirmed action.
brand: <Brand for the output filename, e.g. Acme>
amazon_account: <advertiser account + country, e.g. Acme US (Seller Central)>

guardrails._note: Required for EW builds. structure_reference identifies the approved campaign-structure card or internal source used for this batch. negative_list_source identifies the product keyword workbook and its Never-Ever tab. own_brand_terms contains atomic brand names/aliases, not generic product phrases. own_asins contains only verified advertised-product ASINs. product_validation_verified may be true only after marketplace, product type, variation, buyability, stock, suppression, and ad eligibility are checked.
guardrails.structure_reference: <approved Figma card or internal structure reference>

naming._note: Campaign name = variable_order joined by delimiter; ad group name drops the shorter form's prefix/suffix tokens (Goal/AdType/EW/Counter/CampCounter/Date). Default preset is EW (this file's variable_order below), the 8-slot Ecom Wizards convention: Goal | Ad Type | Match Type | Trigger Words | Product Identifier | Keyword | Camp Counter | Suffix. Set `preset: "LEGACY"` to use the pre-v2 6-token order instead (Goal | SP | MatchType | ProductName | TargetDescriptor | EW). Extra tokens available: Counter, CampCounter (Halo only, blank otherwise), Date, Custom1, Custom2, CampaignType.

defaults._note: Per-campaign fields override these. state=paused is the safety default: campaigns only go live when the operator flips them on after upload (or explicitly asks for enabled). child_state empty makes ad groups, product ads, targets, keywords, and negatives inherit the campaign state; set child_state=enabled when campaigns must remain paused but all child entities should be upload-ready. start_date empty = today. Placements are whole-number percentages (0 = no Bidding Adjustment row). keyword_bid is a LEGACY fallback; EW builds calculate each target bid from suggested_bids.

campaigns._note: One entry per campaign spec; SKW fans out to one campaign per keyword, transpose_keywords chunks keywords into keywords_per_campaign-sized campaigns. campaign_type: SKW (exact, Rank) | Halo (exact, Profit) | Phrase | Auto (one enabled auto group, other three paused) | PAT (ASIN targeting via target_asins; match_type ASIN_EXACT or ASIN_EXPANDED). Sponsored Products BMM is disabled. EW builds require campaign_name and ad_group_name copied exactly from the approved Figma card; the builder validates them but does not invent agency names. goal/match_type/bidding_strategy empty = campaign-type default. campaign_purpose (optional) overrides the approved bidding default and EW trigger word: SHIELD (own-brand SKW/Phrase, down only), SELF_TARGETING (self-PAT, up and down), CATEGORY (up and down). EW builds require campaign-level Negative Phrase brand exclusions in generic campaigns and block those exclusions in Shield campaigns.
campaigns.campaign_name: <exact approved Figma campaign name ending in | EW>
campaigns.ad_group_name: <campaign name without only the first goal and final EW tokens; append ' - variation' only for a real child/pack>
campaigns.product_name: <short product label for the campaign name>
campaigns.target_descriptor: <targeting label for the name, e.g. generic>
asin: <ASIN, optional for sellers, required for vendors>
campaigns.approved_bidding_strategy: <Down only|Up and down|Fixed bids, copied from Figma>
